use_case_summary: Customer building RAG-enabled clinical search where embeddings power retrieval and a lightweight transformer reranker improves precision on top-K. Must support massive index scale (tens of millions of documents), predictable per-query cost, and sub-250ms median tail latency for 95th percentile on triage queries. PHI retention and strict access logging are non-negotiable.
index_scale_requirements: Target index: 40-60M clinical records -> ~1.2B embedding vectors after chunking. Need shard strategy, cold/warm tiering, and incremental reindexing. Expect peak QPS 250 for triage workload and sustained QPS 60 for search UI.
latency_and_cost_targets: Latency SLO: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 250ms for retrieval+rerank. Cost target: blended <$0.02/query at 3M qps-month. Will evaluate batching, KV cache hit rates, and quantized model variants to trade accuracy vs cost.
security_review: Requires BAA + SOC2 Type II evidence. Security team wants HSM-backed KMS, end-to-end TLS with mTLS for internal services, immutable query audit logs (user id, token, query hash, returned doc ids), and configurable retention windows. Air-gapped on-prem option requested for select customers.
poc_success_criteria: 1) p95 latency < 250ms under representative load; 2) reranker improves top1 precision by >= 8% on labeled clinical test set; 3) audit logs show per-query provenance and can be exported to customer SIEM; 4) cost model predicts <$0.02/query at scale.
